435. Maximize Rope Length After Cuts

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
There are N ropes of integer lengths L[i], (1 <= i <= N). In one operation, you pick a rope and cut it by half.That is L[i] := L[i] - ceil(L[i]/2), once the length of the rope becomes 0, you cannot pick it again. Let the sum of L[i] over all i at an instance be f(L). You are given an integer Q. Find the maximum value of f(L) after performing Q operations.
input_spec: The first line contains two integers N and Q denoting the number of ropes and the number of operations to be performed.The next line contains N space separated integers L[i] (1
output_spec: Print the maximum value of f(L)
